profile.name: IEEE 488.2 通用实验室仪器
profile.description: 符合 IEEE 488.2 标准的通用实验室测试仪器，可通过标准公共命令完成设备识别、复位、自检、触发、状态寄存器管理以及仪器状态的保存与恢复。此类设备常见于各类台式电子测量仪器中。
profile.description_en: A generic laboratory test instrument compliant with the IEEE 488.2 standard. It supports standard common commands for identification, reset, self-test, triggering, status register handling, and instrument state save/recall. This device class is commonly found in bench electronic test instruments.
